objective: Reconstruct full-field bridge seismic response under matched sensor-free and sensor-assisted conditions.
known_at_deployment: sensor acceleration only when sensors are available
sensor_free_input: ground acceleration plus identically zero sensor values and identically zero sensor mask
sensor_assisted_input: the same ground acceleration plus sparse absolute sensor acceleration and its availability mask
secondary_evaluation: per-direction waveform, peak and peak-time metrics

data_policy.development_split: deterministic hash split within the 549 training records
data_policy.external_evaluation_split: the 157 historical validation records; report only, not a pristine final test
data_policy.formal_test_split: 78 untouched records; evaluate only after checkpoint and strategy selection are frozen

fairness_invariants: B0 and B1 use identical architecture and parameter count
B0 and B1 use identical data split, optimizer budget, seed and evaluation code
only sensor values and mask differ
observed sensor rows are excluded from the primary metric
forbidden: using unobserved response truth as model input
using historical validation truth for training or checkpoint selection
selecting only favorable earthquakes, nodes, directions or seeds
replacing the independent acceleration target with acceleration differentiated from predicted displacement
reducing the output to only pier or sensor nodes
overwriting retained baseline checkpoints or completed immutable cases

retention_rule.primary: at least 5 percent unobserved-node RMSE reduction relative to the matched float baseline
retention_rule.safety: peak error degradation no greater than 2 percent
retention_rule.sensor_value: B1 beats B0 on at least 65 percent of records
retention_rule.robustness: directionally consistent improvement over three seeds before a strong claim
